InputMap.bindings:
move_x = d, a:-1, gamepad.lx
move_y = w, s:-1, gamepad.ly
jump = space, gamepad.a
sprint = shift, gamepad.ls
sneak = control, gamepad.rs
flash = f, gamepad.y
deadzone = 0.15

systems.name: fp_axes
systems.doc: Which way is ahead and to the right on the ground, from the look.

systems.name: fp_walk
systems.doc: Walk, sprint (stamina), creep, jump; F is the flashlight.

systems.name: bodycam
systems.doc: The camera is on the chest: it sways with the step, rolls a little, breathes.

systems.name: bodycam_clock
systems.doc: The recorder's clock: hours, minutes and seconds as digits for the on-screen text; the red dot blinks.

systems.name: flicker
systems.doc: The fluorescent lights of the Lobby: each is steady, most of the time, then stutters.

systems.name: ambience
systems.doc: The beds of sound: the tubes buzz in the Lobby and are gone in the hall, the pump drone is the other way round.

systems.name: giant
systems.doc: The Giant walks the length of the basin at 6 m a second (one step in about four seconds, as it plays), and turns at the ends.
